column.description: The column where the finding starts (1-based, counted in Unicode code points).

doc_url.description: The documentation of the rule. It is omitted for custom rules.

end_column.description: The column of the last character of the indicator in snippet, counted in Unicode code points like column, not in display width. It equals column when no indicator can be shown. It is not the exclusive end of the region.

end_line.description: The line where the region of the finding ends. It is equal to line unless the region spans several lines.

events.description: The sorted names of the events which trigger the workflow. Only with --finding-context, and for a workflow.

filepath.description: The path of the file, relative to the working directory when possible. It is <stdin> for the input of stdin without a name, or the value of --stdin-filename.

fix.description: The automatic fix. It is omitted when the finding has none.

edits.description: The replacements, which do not overlap.

end.description: The byte offset just after the replaced range.

new_text.description: The text put in place of the range.

start.description: The byte offset where the replaced range starts.

unsafe.description: The fix may change the behavior of the workflow, so --fix applies it only with --fix=unsafe. It is omitted when false.

id.description: The stable ID of the rule, like unpinned-uses. See https://jactionlint.jdx.dev/rules. A custom rule has its name as ID.

kind.description: The legacy name of the checker which reported the finding. Several rules share a kind, and it is not always a rule ID. Legacy: use id.

line.description: The line where the finding starts (1-based).

no_fix.description: Why a finding which the rule can fix has no fix. It is omitted when the finding has a fix or is advice only.

option.description: The rule option to configure, as rule-id.option, for option-required and option-invalid.

permissions.description: The permissions of the token of the job the finding is in, scope to read, write, none or unknown (an expression decides it); the scope * is read-all, write-all, an empty mapping (none) or an expression (unknown). Only with --finding-context, and when the file configures them.

snippet.description: The lines of the source with the indicator (^~~~) under the region. It is omitted when empty.

description: The output of `jactionlint --format json`: an array of findings. `--format jsonl` prints one finding per line, each valid against #/definitions/finding. Fields are never removed or renamed within a major version; new fields can appear, so readers must ignore the fields they do not know. Generated by `jactionlint --print-output-schema`.
title: jactionlint findings
